official_mcp.method: Official-domain search and published documentation index; no endpoint scans or guesses.

implementation.scope: Documented REST API wrapper; does not modify kit source.

verification.execution_note: Python asyncio Windows socketpair blocks in restricted sandbox; offline protocol tests passed under approved non-sandbox execution. Host-launch MCP is the intended runtime.

authentication.source: Injected FREYA_API_KEY/FREYA_BANK_TEAM_KEY or explicit --env-file path. No dotenv search or credential-store discovery.
authentication.workspace_selector: FREYA_WORKSPACE_ID required if the key sees multiple workspaces.
authentication.bank_team_key: 16+ characters required for practice sessions/ledger and explicit bank-key placeholder injection; parent supplies privately.
authentication.secret_outputs: Response, transcript, export, state, and errors are redacted; no credential values in this report.

controls.single_simulation: Persistent per-remote-workspace marker + nonblocking cross-process OS lock + documented remote running check. Platform provides final global cap.
controls.nonblocking: start returns id; status fetches once. Poll every 10 seconds.
controls.stable_workflows: save reuses slot and publishes after update; bind slot recovers uncertain creation.
controls.unknown_write_outcome: No automatic write retries; reconcile workflow id or adopt known simulation id.
controls.bank_placeholder: ${FREYA_BANK_TEAM_KEY} injected only into save/update/start payloads in memory. Dry-run does not need bank key.
controls.export: Fixed integration/exports directory; redacted exports need credentials restored through an authorized flow before use.

parent_handoff.registration: Merge codex-mcp.toml [mcp_servers.freya] into trusted project .codex/config.toml, preserving current entries. Use parent's DPAPI launcher in command/args if needed. No global config written.
parent_handoff.reload: Reload the client or open a fresh chat; current tool catalog is unchanged by this handoff.
parent_handoff.optional_plugin: plugin/freya-mcp/plugin.json + mcp.json; scoped catalog plugin/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json. See README for exact isolated-home registration commands. Choose standalone or plugin route once.
